technical_translation: Use as a local radial-angular support or chart for reach, shelling, orientation and uncertainty.
caveat: The mature corpus rejects a globally spherical replacement for every representation.

source_meaning: Admissible local field around a coupler, sensor or entity.
technical_translation: A bounded set S_q or constraint C(q,t)≤0 in radius and angles.
caveat: Must specify coordinates, tolerance and measurement boundary.

source_meaning: Lighthouse beam, sensor cone, causal cone, support region.
technical_translation: Analytic domain of relevance/influence; a query filter rather than necessarily a rendered ray bundle.
caveat: A cone alone does not solve visibility, dynamics or chemistry.

source_meaning: A cone rotating around an origin or boundary.
technical_translation: Time-parameterized angular support or scanning aperture.
caveat: Claims of infinite angular velocity near a log-polar origin are coordinate singularity rhetoric, not free computation.

technical_translation: Routing partition with a rank-changing event locus and invariant axis.
Finite-state transition diagram over sheet and route bits.
caveat: Requires explicit transition table and invariants.

technical_translation: Guard/event surface where a transition is declared; in photonics it may be a cutoff, dark port or critical-coupling threshold.
caveat: Must be measured; it is not automatically an eigenvalue collapse.

technical_translation: Scalar field d(x) whose zero level set describes a boundary; sign labels sides when orientability permits.
caveat: Combined CSG expressions may not remain exact Euclidean distances; evaluation may still require numerical methods.
source_anchors: Hollowland pp.16-18; KC Vector Art pp.1-3

technical_translation: Explicit event/guard/transition relation rather than a point to march past.
caveat: Zero does not itself prove exact root solving or eliminate sampling.

technical_translation: Two sides of an oriented implicit surface.
caveat: A global sign is problematic on a non-orientable surface without a covering-space or local-orientation convention.

source_meaning: No clean inside/outside, looping orientation flip.
technical_translation: A closed non-orientable surface; useful as a routing/gluing abstraction with explicit port and orientation maps.
caveat: A familiar 3D model self-intersects; literal non-orientable hardware is not validated.

source_meaning: Inside and outside become one continuous side.
technical_translation: A non-orientable band with one boundary component; a simple orientation-reversing gluing example.

source_meaning: Turning a sphere inside out without tearing.
technical_translation: A regular homotopy of an immersed sphere in 3D allowing self-intersections.
caveat: Not a material deformation without self-intersection; does not imply a Klein bottle reversal mechanism.
